alt: A 9-second vertical video with our own music and no voice. On a lime green field with pop stars, Cella, a small dark doorway-shaped figure with two white eyes and a flat red crown, stands below her list: a sticker reads “Things I do before 6 AM”, huge pink word-art reads “1. Sleep.”, then “Beautifully.” appears, and a sticker says © CELLA. Cella closes her eyes, proud, breathing slowly.
comentario_fijado: Her list is shorter. What’s on yours before 6 AM? One word.
experimento_prueba: control pareado de before-6-am-by-cella: la misma lámina, música, pose y hora UTC, sin la tarjeta de gurú; la única variable es la interrupción
